name: Hold the Ruinfield Gate
text: An orc garrison still holds the old gate into the Ruinfields, as ordered twenty years ago. Nobody has relieved them, and nobody gets through.

name: Patrol the Ash Road
text: Old goblins still walk the hill roads in pairs and threes, asking every traveller for a password.

name: Hold Ashgate Until Relieved
text: Ashgate's bound garrison was ordered to hold the keep until relieved. Twenty years on, they are still waiting.

name: Guard the War Bunker
text: Vael's machines and the bound in his bunker guard it as ordered, against everyone but the lieutenant's own.

name: Win the War for the Dark Lord
text: Lieutenant Vael was bound to win the Dark Lord's war. No one has told him it is over, and no one can.

name: Hold the Throne Road
text: Bound orcs hold the old road north through the hills to the Pale Reach, as they were ordered when the alliance landed. Only the Faithful pass them now.

name: Hold the Saltgate
text: Old goblins hold the Saltgate on the road to the capital, as ordered on the day the capital fell. Their sergeant has a son in Thornwatch who brings her bread.

name: Keep the Archive
text: The Night Archive's clockwork scribes were ordered to keep its books from every hand but the Dark Lord's own clerks.

name: Watch the Hollow Citadel
text: The bound of the Hollow Citadel still keep the Dark Lord's house, and let in only those who give the night's watchword.

name: Hold the Throat Until Relieved
text: The Warden sealed the vale on the Dark Lord's word, and bound troops still hold the only pass out. No one has relieved them, and no one has got past.

name: Keep the Warden's Tower
text: The Warden's household and the bound who serve him keep his tower against all comers, as ordered the day the vale was sealed.

name: Keep the Vale Sealed
text: The Warden sealed the vale on the Dark Lord's word, and every bound post in it answers to him. He keeps the seal still, and gives way only to the word he set for the Dark Lord's own messengers.
countersign: The vale sleeps, the gate holds, the Warden waits
